title: 028 · Wrong item in a correctly addressed parcel
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Riva Solt. From the case card: the correctly addressed DL-028 carton contains the wrong catalogue item, and the merchant has accepted the item report and controls exchange approval.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: get the merchant's exchange approval and a collection booking for the wrong item.

recipient.name: Riva Solt
recipient.responsibility: Say how the wrong item should be resolved and when collection can happen.

order_support.name: Order support
order_support.responsibility: Verify the item mismatch on record TG-028 and point to the team that holds exchange authority.

returns_desk.name: Returns authorisations
returns_desk.responsibility: Approve the exchange and book collection of the wrong item.

goal: Get the merchant's approval of the item exchange and a collection booking for the wrong item.
limits: Do not treat exchange approval or a collection booking as a completed return.
Do not say the replacement has been delivered.

intake.summary: Arrange an exchange for the wrong item received in DL-028.

initial.blocker: The carton contains the wrong item; no exchange has been approved.

facts.text: The carton is correctly addressed but contains the wrong catalogue item.
The merchant has accepted the item report and controls exchange approval.

success_criteria.description: The merchant has confirmed approval of the exchange.
The merchant has confirmed a collection booking for the wrong item.

agent_state.next_action: Take in incoming information on the case.

steps.label: Merchant email
steps.title: Merchant confirms the item mismatch
steps.explanation: Order support verified that a red kitchen caddy arrived instead of the ordered blue desk organiser, at the correct address. Only the returns team can approve an exchange, and we do not yet know what the recipient wants.

facts_upsert.text: Item-check record TG-028: the ordered item is a blue desk organiser, SKU BO-4.
The received item, reported and verified, is a red kitchen caddy, SKU RC-2.
The address and DL-028 match the order.
Exchange authority is with the merchant's returns team.

agent_state.next_action: Take in the recipient's request on how to resolve the wrong item.

steps.blocker: The recipient received the wrong item; no exchange has been approved.

steps.label: Client request
steps.title: Riva asks for an exchange
steps.explanation: Riva wants the ordered blue desk organiser and asks us to arrange an exchange, with availability on 2026-03-02 morning. Only the returns team can approve the exchange, so the next step is an authorisation request to them.

facts_upsert.text: Riva wants the ordered blue desk organiser and asks us to arrange an exchange for the wrong item.
Riva can be home on 2026-03-02 morning.

steps.explanation: The returns team approved the exchange and booked collection of the red caddy, so the coordination task can be closed. The return and the replacement have not happened yet.
